comments.value:
I would enjoy a "cinematic" camera mode that could slowly rotate around the user and/or selected group of people.

Alot of people, including a dear friend of mine, create content and movies with the camera and different cinematic angles could really help out those users alot! (Like flying in a jet and trying to get cool shots/video in the air; with the current camera settings, it's next to impossible to film something like that).

Multiple camera angles for filming could help out a lot too so a scene doesn't need to be shot so many times to get the best shot taken; basically the different angles would film with how ever many angles the camera are set up.

If possible a camera "bubble" where anything that happens in the "bubble" gets filmed and in editing, anywhere in said bubble could be used as a camera angle.

details:
I've been trying my hand at some machinima-like things lately! But the camera could use some extra features, I think. These aren't all the features I think would be useful, but I can't quite fully work out the others, so I won't include them.

1) Set camera movement speed. A preset speed that will happen no matter how little or how much you hold the stick. Keeping the speed constant during shots can be so difficult.

2) Record/replay camera movement. Click record, perform a movement, then replay on command. Good for reshoots~

3) Disable maximum camera distance. If we're worried about people using it for spying, maybe include this as an optional toggle for a new instance, and warn people on joining with a yes/no prompt to enter.

4) Maybe a slider for the camera smoothing? More/less smoothing

Also, having all these options available in desktop would be wonderful too. It's a pain having to get into VR every time I want to do a little recording.
title: More Camera controls
